verdict.rationale: Qodo is a SaaS code-review platform that offers an official MCP server and CLI for agents, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair question. The evidence never describes API keys, tokens, or per-credential scopes. The closest items are admin control over which users can access the Agentic Toolbox and a local rwx process-permission toggle in the CLI, but neither is a scoped or least-privilege API credential for an agent.
